snippet.title: Out of Stock! - Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist the game now on Steam  🛒✨ : https://store.steampowered.com/app/1938750/Out_of_Stock/

We are thrilled to share with you the trailer for our game Out of Stock!! 

Team up with your friends in this frantic 4-player co-op party game! Order, restock, scrub the floor, but most importantly, keep your customers happy, or bad reviews will pile up fast!
